videos.overview: The Doctor is forced to co-operate with the Animus but Ian uses the opportunity to make an escape attempt.

videos.title: Crater of Needles
videos.overview: Ian and Vrestin are captured by the subterranean Optera while Barbara and her Menoptera allies attempt to escape from the slave camp.

videos.title: Invasion
videos.overview: Barbara and the surviving Menoptera take refuge in the Temple of Light while the Doctor and Vicki attempt to escape by taking control of a Zarbi.

videos.title: The Centre
videos.overview: The Doctor and Vicki are taken before the Animus but the isoptope is left behind in the laboratory.The only hope of victory lies with Barbara and her Menoptera allies.

videos.title: The Lion
videos.overview: The TARDIS lands in the Holy Land during the Third Crusade and the crew help save Richard the Lionheart from an ambush, but Barbara is captured and brought before Saladin.

videos.title: The Knight of Jaffa
videos.overview: While the Doctor, Ian, and Vicki are drawn into the intrigues of King Richard's court, Barbara has to cope with an impatient Saladin and the vengeful El Akir.

videos.title: The Wheel of Fortune
videos.overview: Barbara allies herself with a man whose wife and son were murdered by El Akir as the Doctor and Vicki are caught up in Richard's plan to offer his sister's hand in marriage to Saladin's brother.

videos.title: The Warlords
videos.overview: Ian sets out with a reluctant accomplice to rescue Barbara from El Akir's palace as the Doctor and Vicki try to evade the suspicions of the Earl of Leicester.

videos.title: The Space Museum
videos.overview: The TARDIS arrives on a planet that has been turned into a space museum but the Doctor and his friends are puzzled when they find themselves out of phase with their surroundings.

videos.title: The Dimensions of Time
videos.overview: Now back on their proper time track, the Doctor and his friends must work to avoid the future they saw for themselves.

videos.title: The Search
videos.overview: With the Doctor missing, Ian, Barbara and Vicki find themselves in danger from the Moroks while the Xerons also try to make contact with them.

videos.title: The Final Phase
videos.overview: While Ian tries to force Lobos to release the Doctor from the museum, Vicki joins the Xerons in trying to gain the weapons needed to start a revolution against the occupiers.

videos.title: The Executioners
videos.overview: The Daleks pursue The Doctor through time and space, with the intentions of exterminating him. Places they land include the Mary Celeste, a haunted house and the empire state building.

videos.title: The Death of Time
videos.overview: While Ian and Vicki are threatened by a Mire Beast, the Doctor and Barbara meet up with the Aridians...who are then ordered to hand them over to the Daleks.

videos.title: Flight Through Eternity
videos.overview: The TARDIS crew's attempts to escape from the Daleks take them to the top of the Empire State Building and a 19th century sailing ship.

videos.title: Journey into Terror
videos.overview: The TARDIS lands in a haunted house where the Doctor and his friends are confronted by Dracula and Frankenstein's Monster...and then the Daleks appear.

videos.title: The Death of Doctor Who
videos.overview: With Vicki trapped on board the Dalek time machine, the Doctor, Ian and Barbara decide to make their stand on the planet Mechanus.

videos.title: The Planet of Decision
videos.overview: The Doctor and his friends are taken into the Mechanoid City but their troubles are far from over...especially when the Daleks launch an attack.

videos.title: The Watcher
videos.overview: The Doctor, Vicki, and Steven Taylor, go to 1066 England, but something doesn't seem right including modern inventions like a Gramaphone and electricity. Could there be another Time Lord?

videos.title: The Meddling Monk
videos.overview: The Doctor is being held prisoner by the Monk and Steven and Vicki's search for him brings them to the Saxon village.But a greater danger threatens when a Viking raiding party arrives.

videos.title: A Battle of Wits
videos.overview: The Doctor manages to escape from his cell and get the upper hand on the Monk but his plans are derailed when Sven and Ulf arrive at the monastery.

videos.title: Checkmate
videos.overview: The Doctor finally discovers what the Monk is up to and must move fast to prevent his opponent from altering the course of history.

videos.title: Four Hundred Dawns
videos.overview: After an encounter with a hostile robot called a Chumblie, the Doctor and his companions are rescued by a group of female Drahvins.

videos.title: Trap of Steel
videos.overview: With the knowledge that the planet will be destroyed in two days, the Drahvins instruct the Doctor to help them steal the Rills' ship.

videos.title: Air Lock
videos.overview: The Doctor and Vicki encounter the Rills and learn the situation is more complex than they thought while Steven finds the Drahvins' hospitality ever more perilous.

videos.title: The Exploding Planet
videos.overview: The Doctor and Vicki enlist the aid of the Chumblies to rescue Steven from the Drahvins and then find a way off the planet before its destruction.

videos.title: Mission to the Unknown
videos.overview: Whilst The Doctor, Steven and Vicki are traveling to their next destination. On the planet Kembel, Marc Cory, a Space Security Service agent discovers The Daleks are attending a secret meeting with their allies. Where Cory discovers the Dalek's evil plan, which sets the stage for the epic 12-part adventure "The Dalek Master Plan".

videos.title: Temple of Secrets
videos.overview: The TARDIS lands in the middle of the Trojan War, where the Doctor is mistaken for the god Zeus.

videos.title: Small Prophet, Quick Return
videos.overview: While Odysseus forces the Doctor to find a way to win the war, Steven decides to get himself taken prisoner in order to enter Troy and find Vicki and the TARDIS.

videos.title: Death of a Spy
videos.overview: With Steven and Vicki being held prisoner by the Trojans, the Doctor's only hope of seeing them again is to suggest the idea of the Trojan Horse.

videos.title: Horse of Destruction
videos.overview: The Doctor waits inside the Trojan Horse for a chance to reach his companions but Steven's assumed identity as a Greek soldier and Vicki's growing feelings for Troilus endanger their escape.

videos.title: The Nightmare Begins
videos.overview: The Doctor runs afoul of the Daleks and Special Security Agent Bret Vyon on the planet Kembel.

videos.title: Day of Armageddon
videos.overview: The Doctor infiltrates the Daleks' conference to try and discover their plans, leaving Steven, Katarina and Bret to find a way off the planet.

videos.title: Devil's Planet
videos.overview: The Doctor and his friends escape Kembel in the Spar ship but the Daleks force them down on the planet Desperus, where they are threatened by a group of convicts.

videos.title: The Traitors
videos.overview: With Katarina being held hostage, the Doctor, Steven and Bret are in danger of having to given in to Kirksen's demands, while, on Earth, Chen has them listed as traitors.

videos.title: Counter Plot
videos.overview: The Doctor, Steven and Sara are accidentally transported to the planet Mira where Chen sends the Daleks after them.

videos.title: Coronas of the Sun
videos.overview: The Doctor, Steven and Sara escape Mira in a Dalek pursuit ship but when they find the ship is returning to Kembel, they are forced to come up with a new plan to avoid the Daleks.

videos.title: The Feast of Steven
videos.overview: The Doctor, Steven and Sara visit a Liverpool police station on Christmas Day and a Hollywood film set during the 1920s.

videos.title: Volcano
videos.overview: The Daleks realise the Doctor has given them a fake Taranium Core while, on the planet Tigus, the Doctor encounters the Meddling Monk.

videos.title: Golden Death
videos.overview: The Doctor, Steven and Sara travel to Ancient Egypt, pursued by both the Daleks and the Meddling Monk.

videos.title: Escape Switch
videos.overview: Steven, Sara and the Monk are captured by the Daleks in order to force the Doctor to hand over the Taranium Core.

videos.title: The Abandoned Planet
videos.overview: The Doctor, Steven and Sara reach Kembel where they find the Daleks have betrayed their allies and imprisoned them.

videos.title: Destruction of Time
videos.overview: With the Daleks poised to invade the solar system, the Doctor decides his only option is to activate the Time Destructor prematurely, threatening the entire planet.

videos.title: War of God
videos.overview: The TARDIS lands in sixteenth century Paris and Steven becomes involved with a group of Huguenots.

videos.title: The Sea Beggar
videos.overview: While trying to find the Doctor, Steven discovers a conspiracy to assassinate a man known as the Sea Beggar.

videos.title: Priest of Death
videos.overview: Steven has discovered the identity of the Sea Beggar, but can he warn the Huguenots in time?

videos.title: Bell of Doom
videos.overview: Steven rejoins the Doctor and they leave Paris just ahead of the massacre, leaving Anne behind.

videos.title: The Steel Sky
videos.overview: The Doctor, Steven and Dodo arrive on a giant spaceship millions of years in the future, transporting the last humans away from the doomed Earth.

videos.title: The Plague
videos.overview: With the Ark infected with a cold virus, the Doctor must convince the Guardians to trust him so he can find a cure.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: The Doctor, Steven and Dodo have travelled 700 years into the future and find that the Ark is now under the control of the Monoids as it approaches Refusis.

videos.title: The Bomb
videos.overview: The Monoids abandon the Ark, leaving Steven and the Guardians to die, but a mutiny in their ranks may give the Doctor a chance to bring about peace.

videos.title: The Celestial Toyroom
videos.overview: The Doctor, Steven and Dodo arrive in the realms of the Celestial Toymaker, who forces them to play his deadly games.

videos.title: The Hall of Dolls
videos.overview: While the Doctor continues to play the Trilogic Game with the Toymaker, Steven and Dodo are involved in a deadly game of musical chairs.

videos.title: The Dancing Floor
videos.overview: Steven and Dodo are forced to cross the dancing floor, where the Toymaker's dolls plan to force them to dance for eternity.

videos.title: The Final Test
videos.overview: As the Doctor nears the end of his game against the Toymaker, Steven and Dodo take on Cyril in a lethal game of hopscotch to try and recover the TARDIS.

videos.title: A Holiday for the Doctor
videos.overview: The TARDIS arrives in Tombstone, Arizona in 1891. Where the Doctor is looking for a dentist when he has a toothache, where The Doctor finds the local dentist is the famous Doc Holliday who is in a feud with The Clanton Brothers and their hired gunfighter Johnny Ringo, whilst local sheriff Wyatt Earp is trying to keep the peace. The Doctor, Steven and Dodo find themselves joining forces with The Clanton Brothers and Sheriff Wyatt Earp.

videos.title: Don't Shoot the Pianist
videos.overview: With the Clantons believing the Doctor to be Doc Holliday, Wyatt Earp takes him into protective custody but this leaves Steven and Dodo in danger.

videos.title: Johnny Ringo
videos.overview: Earp comes to Steven's rescue and arrests Phineas Clanton, prompting the Clantons to decide to enlist the help of Johnny Ringo.

videos.title: The O.K. Corral
videos.overview: The Clantons have shot Warren Earp, leading to a showdown between the two families with the Doctor powerless to prevent bloodshed.

videos.title: The Savages (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Steven and Dodo arrive in the far future and are welcomed by the advanced civilisation of the Elders but soon begin to suspect they are hiding a secret.

videos.title: The Savages (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Steven and Dodo investigate why there are Savages in the Elders' city and uncover the true price of the Elders' perfect society.

videos.title: The Savages (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor has been subjected to the Elders' extraction process and Steven and Dodo must return to their city to rescue him.

videos.title: The Savages (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor urges the Savages to finally bring an end to the Elders' oppression and enlists the help of an unlikely ally.

videos.title: The War Machines (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Dodo return to London in the present day where the Doctor becomes concerned about WOTAN, a new super-computer installed in the Post Officer Tower.

videos.title: The War Machines (2)
videos.overview: Dodo is under the control of WOTAN and attempts to lure the Doctor into a trap, while the rest of WOTAN's slaves begin construction on its robotic War Machines.

videos.title: The War Machines (3)
videos.overview: Ben tries to escape from the warehouse but is captured by Polly, who is now also under WOTAN's control, and forced to work on construction the War Machine.

videos.title: The War Machines (4)
videos.overview: The first War Machine is defeated but the Doctor only has a matter of hours to destroy WOTAN before the rest of its army is activated.

videos.title: The Smugglers (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor discovers Polly and Ben aboard the TARDIS shortly before the ship arrives in 17th century Cornwall, where the local churchwarden gives the Doctor a cryptic message shortly before being murdered.

videos.title: The Smugglers (2)
videos.overview: Pike is convinced that the Doctor knows the location of Avery's treasure while Polly and Ben try to convince the locals they were not responsible for Longfoot's murder.

videos.title: The Smugglers (3)
videos.overview: Polly and Ben are placed in the custody of Blake, who reveals he also has his suspicions about the Squire, while the Doctor and Kewper are forced to team up to escape from Pike's ship.

videos.title: The Smugglers (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor and his friends are at the mercy of Cherub, who is now seeking Avery's treasure for himself, while Pike prepares to attack the village.

videos.title: The Tenth Planet (1)
videos.overview: In 1986 a new planet appears in the Solar System which turns out to be a long-lost twin of Earth's named Mondas. Its inhabitants are the Cybermen.

videos.title: The Tenth Planet (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor's warnings are ignored and the Cybermen take over the base, hampering the crew's efforts to help Zeus IV.

videos.title: The Tenth Planet (3)
videos.overview: With the Doctor out of action, it is up to Polly, Ben and Barclay to stop Cutler using the Z-Bomb and devastating half the world.

videos.title: The Tenth Planet (4)
videos.overview: The Cybermen take over the base again, apparently to stop the humans using the Z-Bomb, but then the Doctor realises they intend to use it themselves to destroy Earth.

videos.title: The Power of the Daleks (1)
videos.overview: The TARDIS arrives on the Earth colony of Vulcan where the newly-regenerated Doctor assumes the identity of an Earth Examiner.

videos.title: The Power of the Daleks (2)
videos.overview: While the Doctor worries about the inert Daleks in the capsules, Lesterson makes plan to reactivate one of them.

videos.title: The Power of the Daleks (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor fails to convince the colonists of the danger posed by the Daleks and soon the other two are also reactivated.

videos.title: The Power of the Daleks (4)
videos.overview: With Polly being held prisoner by the rebels, the Doctor and Ben decide to investigate them, while Lesterson discovers the Daleks are reproducing.

videos.title: The Power of the Daleks (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Quinn attempt to escape in order to stop Bragen using the Daleks to take over the colony.

videos.title: The Power of the Daleks (6)
videos.overview: With Bragen having taken over, the Daleks trick the rebels into turning them loose and only the Doctor can stop them wiping out the entire colony.

videos.title: The Highlanders (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Polly and Ben arrive in 1746, in the aftermath of the Battle of Culloden, and are captured by a group of Highlanders shortly before they themselves are captured by redcoats.

videos.title: The Highlanders (2)
videos.overview: Polly and Kirsty capture Lieutenant Ffinch to try and enlist his help while the Doctor tricks Grey in order to escape.

videos.title: The Highlanders (3)
videos.overview: With the Highlanders imprisoned aboard Trask's ship, the Doctor attempts to expose Grey's plan.

videos.title: The Highlanders (4)
videos.overview: Ben manages to join up with the Doctor, Polly and Kirsty and together they work to free the Highlanders from Trask's ship before Grey sells them into slavery.

videos.title: The Underwater Menace (1)
videos.overview: The TARDIS materialises on a deserted beach where the Doctor and his friends are captured by primitive warriors and taken to the fabled city of Atlantis.

videos.title: The Underwater Menace (2)
videos.overview: While Ara tries to save Polly from being turned into a Fish Person and Ben and Jamie try to escape from the mines, the Doctor discovers the full extent of Zaroff's plans.

videos.title: The Underwater Menace (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Ramo are sentenced to be sacrificed to the goddess Amdo and must escape to put a stop to Zaroff's plan.

videos.title: The Underwater Menace (4)
videos.overview: With Zaroff's plan nearing completion, the Doctor and Ben realise the only way to save the world is to destroy Atlantis.

videos.title: The Moonbase (1)
videos.overview: The TARDIS arrives on the Moon in the year 2070.When Jamie is injured, the other travellers are forced to seek the help of a moonbase afflicted with a space plague.

videos.title: The Moonbase (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and his friends attempt to convince the Moonbase crew that the Cybermen are responsible for the disappearances and find a cure for the plague.

videos.title: The Moonbase (3)
videos.overview: The Cybermen take over the Moonbase and begin using the Gravitron to attack Earth but Polly, Ben and Jamie come up with a way to fight back.

videos.title: The Moonbase (4)
videos.overview: With the Cybermen preparing to launch a full attack, the Doctor and his friends must keep the Moonbase and the Gravitron out of their hands until help arrives from Earth.

videos.title: The Macra Terror (1)
videos.overview: The TARDIS arrives at a holiday camp company with the crew worried by a prediction of giant crabs and the Doctor becomes interested in the apparent madman Medok's stories of creatures that roam the colony at night.

videos.title: The Macra Terror (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor is unable to convince the colonists that the Macra exist and an attempt to brainwash his companions results in Ben betraying his friends.

videos.title: The Macra Terror (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Polly and Jamie are sentenced to work in the pits and an escape attempt sees Ben's loyalties called into question again.

videos.title: The Macra Terror (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Polly manage to save Jamie from the Macra and then try to show the Pilot who is really in charge of the colony.

videos.title: The Faceless Ones (1)
videos.overview: The TARDIS materialises on the runway of Gatwick Airport, where Polly witnesses a murder only to be kidnapped before she can report it.

videos.title: The Faceless Ones (2)
videos.overview: With Polly having apparently forgotten them, the Doctor, Ben and Jamie decide to carry out their own investigation of Chameleon Tours.

videos.title: The Faceless Ones (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jamie and Sam manage to convince Crossland to trust them and he persuades the Commandant to let them continue their investigation.

videos.title: The Faceless Ones (4)
videos.overview: When Spencer attempts to kill them, the Doctor, Jamie and Sam become convinced Chameleon Tours are hiding something and Sam decides to book a ticket on one of their flights.

videos.title: The Faceless Ones (5)
videos.overview: Jamie finds himself aboard the Chameleons' satellite and meets their Director while the Doctor forces the Chameleon Meadows to tell him the aliens' plans.

videos.title: The Faceless Ones (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Pinto are captured by the Chameleons but the Doctor manages to use their dependence on their human originals to create dissent in their ranks.

videos.title: The Evil of the Daleks (1)
videos.overview: Trying to find the stolen TARDIS, the Second Doctor and Jamie are lured into a trap by the Doctor's old enemies the Daleks.

videos.title: The Evil of the Daleks (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jamie investigate Waterfield's antiques shop, where they are knocked unconscious and transported back to the 19th century.

videos.title: The Evil of the Daleks (3)
videos.overview: As part of the Daleks' experiment, the Doctor manipulates Jamie into attempting to rescue Victoria.

videos.title: The Evil of the Daleks (4)
videos.overview: Jamie and Kemel team up to try and find Victoria, while the Doctor and the Daleks continue to monitor their progress.

videos.title: The Evil of the Daleks (5)
videos.overview: With the experiment at an end, the Doctor begins to suspect the key to rescuing Jamie, Victoria and Kemel from the Daleks lies with Terrall.

videos.title: The Evil of the Daleks (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jamie and Waterfield follow the Daleks to Skaro, where they discover an unforeseen consequence to their experiment.

videos.title: The Evil of the Daleks (7)
videos.overview: The Daleks are poised to spread the Dalek Factor throughout the history of Earth and begin by implanting the Doctor.

videos.title: The Tomb of the Cybermen (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jamie and Victoria arrive on Telos, where an archaeological group are exploring the Tomb of the Cybermen. But are the Cybermen as dormant as they believe?

videos.title: The Tomb of the Cybermen (2)
videos.overview: The archaeologists learn they are stranded on Telos and Klieg suggests they use the opportunity to explore the Cybermen's tombs.

videos.title: The Tomb of the Cybermen (3)
videos.overview: The Cybermen have been revived and plan to convert the archeologists into their own kind, prompting Hopper to attempt a rescue.

videos.title: The Tomb of the Cybermen (4)
videos.overview: Klieg attempts to do a deal with the Cybercontroller while the Doctor tries to find a way to refreeze the Cybermen permanently.

videos.title: The Abominable Snowmen (1)
videos.overview: When the TARDIS materialises in the Himalayas, the Doctor decides to pay a return visit to the nearby Det-Sen monastery only to be accused of murder.

videos.title: The Abominable Snowmen (2)
videos.overview: Jamie and Victoria make their way to the monastery shortly before it is attacked by the Yeti.

videos.title: The Abominable Snowmen (3)
videos.overview: While the Doctor and Jamie return to the TARDIS for equipment, the control sphere Jamie brought to the monastery is reactivated.

videos.title: The Abominable Snowmen (4)
videos.overview: The Yeti escapes from the monastery and Victoria and Thonmi are accused of assisting it, while the Doctor and Jamie endure a perilous journey back across the mountains.

videos.title: The Abominable Snowmen (5)
videos.overview: Victoria falls under the mental influence of Padmasambhva as the Yeti attack in order to drive the monks from the area.

videos.title: The Abominable Snowmen (6)
videos.overview: With the Great Intelligence on the verge of becoming corporeal, the Doctor challenges Padmasambhva to a mental battle in order to defeat it.

videos.title: The Ice Warriors (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jamie and Victoria are brought to a base which is attempting to halt the flow of the Second Ice Age.

videos.title: The Ice Warriors (2)
videos.overview: Varga revives and takes Victoria hostage as he works to revive his crew while the Doctor and Jamie find Penley stealing medical supplies.

videos.title: The Ice Warriors (3)
videos.overview: Jamie and Arden venture out to rescue Victoria only to find the rest of the Ice Warriors are now active.

videos.title: The Ice Warriors (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor leaves the base to try and find Jamie and Victoria while Storr tries to do a deal with the Ice Warriors.

videos.title: The Ice Warriors (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Victoria are both held prisoner by the Ice Warriors as Varga decides to take over Brittanicus.

videos.title: The Ice Warriors (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Victoria attempt to force the Ice Warriors to surrender control of the ioniser before the ice flow destroys them.

videos.title: The Enemy of the World (1)
videos.overview: After the Doctor is attacked by a group of mysterious gunmen, he discovers he is the physical double of the famous scientist Salamander.

videos.title: The Enemy of the World (2)
videos.overview: Jamie and Victoria agree to accompany Astrid to Hungary to observe Salamander's activities.

videos.title: The Enemy of the World (3)
videos.overview: Jamie and Victoria join Astrid into attempting to rescue Denes but Salamander becomes suspicious of them.

videos.title: The Enemy of the World (4)
videos.overview: Fariah brings the Doctor and Kent evidence of Salamander's activities but then they come under attack from Benik.

videos.title: The Enemy of the World (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor persuades Bruce to help him infiltrate Salamander's research centre while Salamander takes drastic action to prevent Swann finding out the truth.

videos.title: The Enemy of the World (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor discovers the true link between Salamander and Kent while Astrid tries to convince the shelter inhabitants they have been lied to.

videos.title: The Web of Fear (1)
videos.overview: The TARDIS becomes trapped in space before ending up in an underground station of a mysteriously deserted London.

videos.title: The Web of Fear (2)
videos.overview: Jamie and Victoria are reunited with Travers before Jamie joins the soldiers in attempting to find out what has happened to the Doctor.

videos.title: The Web of Fear (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Victoria are taken back to the Goodge Street base by Colonel Lethbridge-Stewart where the Doctor becomes convinced there is a traitor in their midst.

videos.title: The Web of Fear (4)
videos.overview: With Travers having been captured by the Yeti, the Doctor attempts to find a way to gain control of the robots while Lethbridge-Stewart tries to recover the TARDIS.

videos.title: The Web of Fear (5)
videos.overview: Victoria and Travers are held prisoner by the Great Intelligence, who is planning to drain the Doctor's mind.

videos.title: The Web of Fear (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor and his friends are held prisoner by the Intelligence and their only hope lies with Jamie, Arnold and a reprogrammed Yeti.

videos.title: Fury from the Deep (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jamie and Victoria are taken prisoner by the staff of a gas refinery, who have lost contact with their drilling rigs and experienced mysterious drops in pressure.

videos.title: Fury from the Deep (2)
videos.overview: Harris asks for the Doctor's help with Maggie, while Van Lutyens and the Chief Engineer attempt to find out what is blocking the impeller.

videos.title: Fury from the Deep (3)
videos.overview: While the Doctor begins his investigation into the weed creatures, Robson is attacked by one at the refinery.

videos.title: Fury from the Deep (4)
videos.overview: Van Lutyens' investigation of the base of the impeller places the Doctor and Jamie in danger from the Weed Creature.

videos.title: Fury from the Deep (5)
videos.overview: With the Weed Creature poised to burst out of the pipeline and attack the base, an encounter with Oak and Quill gives the Doctor a vital clue about its weakness.

videos.title: Fury from the Deep (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jamie rescue Victoria from Robson and realise they can destroy the Weed Creature with sound waves.

videos.title: The Wheel in Space (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jamie arrive on a mysterious spacecraft whose only occupant is a dangerous Servo Robot.

videos.title: The Wheel in Space (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jamie are brought aboard the Wheel where Jamie is horrified to learn the crew plan to destroy the Silver Carrier with the TARDIS on board.

videos.title: The Wheel in Space (3)
videos.overview: Jamie sabotages the Wheel's x-ray laser, unknowingly giving the Cybermen an opportunity to reach the Wheel.

videos.title: The Wheel in Space (4)
videos.overview: The Cybermen instruct their human slaves to smuggle them onto the Wheel while the Doctor attempts to convince Bennett of the threat they pose.

videos.title: The Wheel in Space (5)
videos.overview: The Cybermen gain control of more members of the Wheel crew and the Doctor realises the only way to stop them is for Jamie and Zoe to make a dangerous space walk.

videos.title: The Wheel in Space (6)
videos.overview: Jamie and Zoe attempt to recover the time vector generator while the Cybermen realise the Doctor is on the Wheel and make him their prime target.

videos.title: The Dominators (1)
videos.overview: The TARDIS arrives on the planet Dulkis where the Doctor, Zoe and Jamie decide to have a quiet holiday. Only to find the Evil Dominators and their robotic slaves, The Quarks have arrived on a radioactive island, where they plan to detonate a bomb in the planet's core, which will turn the entire planet as source of radioactive fuel for their invasion fleet.

videos.title: The Dominators (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jamie are captured by the Dominators, who subject them to an intelligence test, while Zoe and Cully attempt to convince the Dulcian council of the threat.

videos.title: The Dominators (3)
videos.overview: Zoe and Cully are captured by the Dominators and put to work alongside the survey team while the Doctor and Jamie decide to return to the island to help.

videos.title: The Dominators (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Zoe are interrogated by Rago, who is planning to present his terms to the Dulcian council, while Jamie and Cully try to find a way to strike back against the Quarks.

videos.title: The Dominators (5)
videos.overview: Jamie and Cully manage to rescue the Doctor's party and together they try to find a way to stop the Dominators before they destroy the entire planet.

videos.title: The Mind Robber (1)
videos.overview: The TARDIS arrives in a white void, having made an emergency take-off to escape the volcanic eruption on Dulkis. The Doctor, Jamie and Zoe find themselves in the Land of Fiction, where characters from the imagination come to life, and The Master, the mysterious ruler, chooses the Doctor to take his place.

videos.title: The Mind Robber (2)
videos.overview: With the TARDIS destroyed, the Doctor, Jamie and Zoe find themselves in a strange forest patrolled by mysterious soldiers.

videos.title: The Mind Robber (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor realises that the travellers are trapped in a world where fiction is real and where creatures are a threat if people believe in them.

videos.title: The Mind Robber (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jamie and Zoe reach the citadel at the centre of the land, where they finally encounter the Master of the Land of Fiction.

videos.title: The Mind Robber (5)
videos.overview: With Jamie and Zoe having been turned into fiction, the Doctor must find a way to save them without suffering the same fate or becoming part of the Master Brain.

videos.title: The Invasion (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and the newly formed UNIT must stop a Cybermen Invasion and a Sinister Industrialist in league with them

videos.title: The Invasion (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jamie are taken prisoner by their mysterious observers and have a reunion with an old friend while Zoe and Isobel carry out their own investigation of IE.

videos.title: The Invasion (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jamie return to the IE factory in search of Zoe and Isobel, where they meet with Professor Watkins and fall foul of Vaughn.

videos.title: The Invasion (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jamie enlist the help of UNIT to rescue Zoe and Isobel before trying to find out what Vaughn is really up to.

videos.title: The Invasion (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jamie tell the Brigadier about the Cybermen but with Rutledge under Vaughn's control he is powerless to act.

videos.title: The Invasion (6)
videos.overview: Captain Turner manages to rescue Jamie and the others, while the Doctor begins working on a way to protect everyone from the Cybermen's hypno-sound signal.

videos.title: The Invasion (7)
videos.overview: With the entire world unconscious apart from the Doctor and his friends, the Cybermen are poised to invade and only Zoe, the Brigadier and a missile crew can stop them.

videos.title: The Invasion (8)
videos.overview: The Cybermen have launched their deadly megatron bomb which will destroy all life on Earth unless the Doctor can deactivate the homing signal.

videos.title: The Krotons (1)
videos.overview: When the TARDIS arrives on the planet of the Gonds, the Doctor, Jamie and Zoe discover a world ruled and enslaved by the Krotons. The brightest Gonds are always chosen to serve as companions of the Krotons and are never seen again...

videos.title: The Krotons (2)
videos.overview: Zoe is selected as a companion for the Krotons and the Doctor insists on joining her.

videos.title: The Krotons (3)
videos.overview: Jamie is held prisoner by the Krotons who intend to recapture the Doctor and Zoe for their mental energy.

videos.title: The Krotons (4)
videos.overview: Selris succeeds in drawing the Krotons out of the Dynatrope but Eelek agrees to hand the Doctor and Zoe over to them in return for their leaving the planet.

videos.title: The Seeds of Death (1)
videos.overview: 21st century Earth is entirely dependent on the T-Mat transport system but the control centre on the moon has stopped functioning. Meanwhile, the Doctor, Jamie and Zoe meet the one man who can solve the crisis.

videos.title: The Seeds of Death (2)
videos.overview: Eldred agrees to supply a rocket for travel to the moon and the Doctor, Jamie and Zoe volunteer to crew it.

videos.title: The Seeds of Death (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jamie and Zoe make it to the moon and join forces with Phipps but the Ice Warriors have gained control of T-mat.

videos.title: The Seeds of Death (4)
videos.overview: The Ice Warriors' seed pods beginning materialising all over the globe while Slaar decides to kill the Doctor by T-matting him into space.

videos.title: The Seeds of Death (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor and his allies manage to return to Earth via T-mat only to find the Ice Warrior has attacked the weather control station.

videos.title: The Seeds of Death (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor manages to create a rain storm to destroy the Martian fungus before trying to find a way to stop the Ice Warriors' invasion fleet.

videos.title: The Space Pirates (1)
videos.overview: Space beacons are being destroyed by pirates, who are salvaging the argonite metal. When the Doctor, Jamie and Zoe arrive on one of the beacons, they are mistaken for pirates.

videos.title: The Space Pirates (2)
videos.overview: With the Doctor, Jamie and Zoe trapped on a beacon segment, Hermack becomes suspicious of the unruly prospector Milo Clancey.

videos.title: The Space Pirates (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jamie and Zoe flee from the Space Corps with Clancey, who decides to seek refuge on Ta.

videos.title: The Space Pirates (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jamie and Zoe are held prisoner by the space pirates while Caven comes up with a plan to throw suspicion onto Clancey.

videos.title: The Space Pirates (5)
videos.overview: Madeleine is revealed to be working with Caven, who comes up with a way to kill the Doctor and his friends whilst framing them for the piracy.

videos.title: The Space Pirates (6)
videos.overview: With Clancey and Issigri trapped aboard the LIZ, the Doctor, Jamie and Zoe try to convince Madeleine to help them before Caven destroys Ta.

videos.title: The War Games (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jamie and Zoe realise they have arrived in the trenches of the First World War, where the sinister General Smythe accuses them of espionage.

videos.title: The War Games (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Zoe manage to escape from Ransom and attempt to rescue Jamie from the military prison.

videos.title: The War Games (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and his friends realise the area is divided into different time zones and decide to return to the château to obtain a map from Smythe.

videos.title: The War Games (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Zoe are transported to the control centre of the war games while Jamie and Lady Jennifer fall foul of American Revolution soldiers.

videos.title: The War Games (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor attempts to rescue Zoe and Carstairs while Jamie and Lady Jennifer try to convince the resistance of the true nature of Von Weich and the others.

videos.title: The War Games (6)
videos.overview: The scientist examines the captured resistance fighters and realises Jamie is a new arrival on the planet while the Doctor, Zoe and Carstairs try to rescue their friends.

videos.title: The War Games (7)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jamie and Carstairs manage to return to the 1917 zone only to be captured by Smythe, who orders the Doctor executed.

videos.title: The War Games (8)
videos.overview: The Doctor and the processing machine have been taken by the Aliens but the resistance are making plans to attack the control centre.

videos.title: The War Games (9)
videos.overview: To prove his loyalty to the Aliens, the Doctor is ordered to reprocess his friends while the Security Chief finally uncovers evidence of the War Chief's treachery.

videos.title: The War Games (10)
videos.overview: The TARDIS is drawn to the planet of the Time Lords where both the Doctor and the War Lord are placed on trial.

videos.title: Spearhead from Space (1)
videos.overview: As the newly-regenerated Doctor arrives on Earth, so does the Nestene too.

videos.title: Spearhead from Space (2)
videos.overview: UNIT's attempts to locate the meteorites are hampered by the mysterious plastic Autons, being constructed by Channing at a nearby factory, while the Doctor makes another attempt to escape from the hospital.

videos.title: Spearhead from Space (3)
videos.overview: Ransome manages to escape from the plastics factory and alert UNIT, prompting the Doctor and the Brigadier to start an investigation.

videos.title: Spearhead from Space (4)
videos.overview: With UNIT's investigation being blocked by the Replica of Scobie, the Doctor and Liz visit Madame Tussaud's to try and find out more as Channing prepares to activate the Autons.

videos.title: Doctor Who and the Silurians (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Liz are summoned to the Wenley Moor Research Centre by the Brigadier, after several staff members suffer nervous breakdowns.

videos.title: Doctor Who and the Silurians (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor attempts to convince people there are monsters in the caves, prompting Major Baker to start shooting at a reptile man.

videos.title: Doctor Who and the Silurians (3)
videos.overview: The Silurians contact Quinn for help in retrieving the creature while the Doctor and the Brigadier organise a search of the moors.

videos.title: Doctor Who and the Silurians (4)
videos.overview: With Quinn dead, the Brigadier decides to take an armed party into the caves, prompting the Doctor to contact the Silurians himself.

videos.title: Doctor Who and the Silurians (5)
videos.overview: Worried about the Old Silurian's growing friendship with the Doctor, the Young Silurian has the scientist infect Baker with a virus and then release him.

videos.title: Doctor Who and the Silurians (6)
videos.overview: While the Doctor and Liz try to find a cure to the virus spread by Baker, the Young Silurian kills the Old Silurian and takes control of his people.

videos.title: Doctor Who and the Silurians (7)
videos.overview: While Liz distributes the cure to the virus, the Doctor discovers the Silurians now plan to wipe out humanity by destroying the Van Allen Belt.

videos.title: The Ambassadors of Death (1)
videos.overview: While the Brigadier investigates a loss of contact with Mars Probe 7, the Doctor realises signals coming from the probe are of extra-terrestrial origin.

videos.title: The Ambassadors of Death (2)
videos.overview: UNIT retrieve the returned Recovery 7 but then Carrington hijacks it while the Doctor and Liz try to decode the signal he sent.

videos.title: The Ambassadors of Death (3)
videos.overview: Carrington is holding the astronauts at a secret location but when he takes the Doctor, Liz and the Brigadier there they find they have been kidnapped.

videos.title: The Ambassadors of Death (4)
videos.overview: Liz has been captured by Reegan's men and the Doctor begins to suspect Taltalian is more involved than he appeared.

videos.title: The Ambassadors of Death (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor decides to take Recovery 7 back into space to search for the missing astronauts but Reegan sabotages the launch.

videos.title: The Ambassadors of Death (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor speaks with the alien captain and learns the astronauts sent to Earth were ambassadors. However, before he can alert the authorities he is kidnapped by Reegan.

videos.title: The Ambassadors of Death (7)
videos.overview: Carrington is planning to expose the aliens on live television and call for an interplanetary war and the Brigadier must rescue the Doctor and Liz in time to stop him.

videos.title: Inferno (1)
videos.overview: England, the near future. UNIT is providing security and scientific support for the Stahlman project, an attempt to tap the Earth's core for energy. But things are already going wrong…

videos.title: Inferno (2)
videos.overview: Strange deaths, men changing into monsters, hot green slime pouring out of the waste pipes – but Professor Stahlman is determined to press ahead with the Inferno project no matter what the cost!

videos.title: Inferno (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor has vanished from the Inferno project… or has he? He finds himself in the same place, but everyone has changed… and the drilling is closer to its deadly conclusion.

videos.title: Inferno (4)
videos.overview: In a parallel England, the Doctor tries desperately to convince his captors of the immense peril they are in. But they are convinced he is a spy. And penetration zero is getting close…

videos.title: Inferno (5)
videos.overview: The parallel Inferno has broken through the Earth's crust, unleashing terrible seismic forces and dooming the planet. The Doctor hopes to return and save his world. But the bestial primords are closing in...

videos.title: Inferno (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor is trapped in a parallel world that is going up in flames. Can he escape in time to save Earth in his own universe?

videos.title: Inferno (7)
videos.overview: The Doctor has escaped the catastrophic destruction of a parallel world. But can he stop Stahlman before he destroys this one?

videos.title: Terror of the Autons (1)
videos.overview: When a Nestene Energy Unit is stolen and a radio telescope sabotaged, the Doctor is contacted by a Time Lord who tells him his old rival the Master is responsible.

videos.title: Terror of the Autons (2)
videos.overview: Attempting to find out where Jo encountered the Master, the Doctor heads to the circus where he falls foul of Rossini.

videos.title: Terror of the Autons (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and the Brigadier head to Farrel's factory but the Master and the Autons have already left and are distributing plastic daffodils around the country.

videos.title: Terror of the Autons (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor discovers the plastic daffodils are designed to fire a spray that asphyxiates people, causing havoc prior to the Nestene's arrival, but before he can alert anyone he and Jo are captured by the Master.

videos.title: The Mind of Evil (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo head to Stangmoor Prison to investigate the Keller Machine, which drains the evil impulses from prisoners' minds, while UNIT are handling security at the first world peace conference.

videos.title: The Mind of Evil (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor is recalled by UNIT to help investigate Cheng-Tiek's murder but is unaware that Chin-Lee is under the control of the Master.

videos.title: The Mind of Evil (3)
videos.overview: Realising Chin-Lee has been using the power of the Keller Machine to carry out assassinations, the Doctor heads back to Stangmoor, only to find the Master has teamed up with Mailer to stage another riot.

videos.title: The Mind of Evil (4)
videos.overview: With the Doctor and Jo being held prisoner, the Master convinces Mailer to help him steal the Thunderbolt.

videos.title: The Mind of Evil (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor is forced to help the Master control the mind parasite while Yates finds out where the Thunderbolt has been taken only to be captured by the Master's men.

videos.title: The Mind of Evil (6)
videos.overview: The Brigadier has recaptured Stangmoor but the Master still has control of the Thunderbolt and the Doctor must find a way to stop him and destroy the Keller Machine.

videos.title: The Claws of Axos (1)
videos.overview: When a mysterious object lands near the Nuton power complex, UNIT investigate and encounter the Axons, a group of aliens who offer the mineral axonite, which can duplicate matter, as a gift.

videos.title: The Claws of Axos (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Winser begin to analyse axonite while Chinn plots to secure its use exclusively for Britain.

videos.title: The Claws of Axos (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo are being held prisoner by Axos while Chinn is forced to organise the worldwide distribution of axonite and the Master returns to the power complex to try and steal the TARDIS.

videos.title: The Claws of Axos (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo escape from Axos but then the Doctor offers the Master a deal; if he helps him repair the TARDIS, they can flee Earth together.

videos.title: Colony in Space (1)
videos.overview: The Time Lords take control of the TARDIS and the Doctor and Jo arrive on an Earth Colony in the 25th century, where a ruthless mining company are using a dinosaur-like creature to force the colonists to leave the planet.

videos.title: Colony in Space (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor discovers an Interplanetary Mining Corporation ship has landed on the planet in order to mine its duralinium, while Norton begins causing trouble at the colony.

videos.title: Colony in Space (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor makes it back to the colony and warns Ashe what Dent is up to but when Jo and Winton try to find proof they are captured.

videos.title: Colony in Space (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor descends into the Primitive city to try and find Jo while the colonists receive a visit from the Adjudicator.

videos.title: Colony in Space (5)
videos.overview: The Master offers to help the colonists in exchange for information on the Primitive city and forces the Doctor to act as a guide by taking Jo hostage.

videos.title: Colony in Space (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor and the Master are taken into the Primitive city, where the Master hopes to find the doomsday weapon, while Dent forces the colonists to leave the planet even though their ship is likely to explode.

videos.title: The Dæmons (1)
videos.overview: Earth, the near future. When an archaological dig at the village of Devil's End goes disastrously wrong, an ancient power begins to revive. Can even the Doctor withstand the power of the Daemons? And just what is the local vicar up to in his spare time?

videos.title: The Dæmons (2)
videos.overview: With the Doctor frozen by the energy release from the barrow, Jo calls Yates and Benton for help, but when the Brigadier tries to join them he finds the village surrounded by a heat barrier.

videos.title: The Dæmons (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor explains to his friends that the Master is trying to gain the power of the last of the Daemons, a race who influenced Earth's development, while the Master brings the rest of the village under his control.

videos.title: The Dæmons (4)
videos.overview: The Master orders Bert to set a trap for the Doctor at the village while a concussed Jo makes for the cavern.

videos.title: The Dæmons (5)
videos.overview: The Master decides to sacrifice Jo to Azal and when the Doctor and his friends try to intervene they come under attack from Bok.

videos.title: Day of the Daleks (1)
videos.overview: When someone tries to assassinate diplomat Sir Reginald Styles, UNIT investigate the possibility his attacker came from the future.

videos.title: Day of the Daleks (2)
videos.overview: Jo uses the guerrillas' time machine to travel to the 22nd century where the Controller tricks her into telling the Daleks where she's come from.

videos.title: Day of the Daleks (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor forces the guerrillas to take him to the 22nd century where he is soon captured by the Controller.

videos.title: Day of the Daleks (4)
videos.overview: The guerrillas infiltrate the Daleks' base to rescue the Doctor and Jo and ask them to return to their own time and alter history before the 20th century is plunged into a Third World War.

videos.title: The Curse of Peladon (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo arrive on the medieval planet Peladon, where the Doctor is mistaken for the Earth Delegate of the Galactic Federation and Jo is mistaken for a princess.

videos.title: The Curse of Peladon (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor is convinced the Ice Warriors are trying to sabotage the conference but his attempts to prove it see him accused of sacrilege.

videos.title: The Curse of Peladon (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor is sentenced to fight Grun to the death and his attempt to escape leads to an encounter with Aggedor.

videos.title: The Curse of Peladon (4)
videos.overview: Hepesh's plan has been exposed but he is still determined to prevent Peladon joining the Galactic Federation by leading a rebellion against the King.

videos.title: The Sea Devils (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo visit the Master at his island prison where the Doctor becomes curious about a number of ships sinking in the area.

videos.title: The Sea Devils (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo are trapped on the fort by a Sea Devil while the Master convinces Trenchard to help him steal some electronic components.

videos.title: The Sea Devils (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor is held prisoner by Trenchard while the Master attempts to contact the Sea Devils.

videos.title: The Sea Devils (4)
videos.overview: The Sea Devils attack the island prison and rescue the Master, prompting the Doctor to venture underwater to try and contact them.

videos.title: The Sea Devils (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor is taken to the Sea Devils' underwater colony where he tries to make peace with the creatures, only for the navy to attack the base.

videos.title: The Sea Devils (6)
videos.overview: The Sea Devils take over the naval base and the Doctor is forced to help the Master find a way to revive their colony.

videos.title: The Mutants (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo arrive on the planet Solos, on a assignment by the Time Lords, where they learn that the native Solonians are mutating into ant-like mutant creatures...

videos.title: The Mutants (2)
videos.overview: Ky transports himself and Jo down to Solos and the Marshal only agrees to help her if the Doctor assists Professor Jaeger in altering Solos' atmosphere.

videos.title: The Mutants (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Varan travel down to Solos to search for Jo and Ky but the Marshal orders his men to pursue them.

videos.title: The Mutants (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor and his friends are led to safety by Professor Sondergaard, who tries to help the Doctor translate the tablets.

videos.title: The Mutants (5)
videos.overview: The Marshal's premature use of Jaeger's experiment is threatening to destroy Solos' atmosphere and the Doctor returns to Skybase to try and correct the damage.

videos.title: The Mutants (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor is forced to help the Marshal cover up his actions with the Investigator but Jo and the others attempt to escape to expose him.

videos.title: The Time Monster (1)
videos.overview: UNIT are invited to observe a demonstration of the new TOMTIT machine, unaware its creator, Professor Thascales, is actually the Master.

videos.title: The Time Monster (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor realises the Master is trying to harness the power of Kronos, last of the Chronovores, but is unaware Percival is harbouring him at the institute.

videos.title: The Time Monster (3)
videos.overview: The Master enlists the help of Krasis to control Kronos while Yates tries to bring the TARDIS to the institute only to come under attack from dangers from the past.

videos.title: The Time Monster (4)
videos.overview: The Master prepares to travel back to Atlantis but the Doctor links his TARDIS to the Master's to try and stop him.

videos.title: The Time Monster (5)
videos.overview: Both TARDISes reach Atlantis, where the Doctor befriends King Dalios while the Master enlists the help of Queen Galleia to try and obtain the crystal of Kronos.

videos.title: The Time Monster (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor enters the labyrinth to try and protect Jo from the minotaur but the Master has seized control of Atlantis and prepares to summon Kronos again.

videos.title: The Three Doctors (1)
videos.overview: England, the near future. A strange anti-matter creature arrives on Earth and attacks UNIT HQ. It seems to be specifically seeking the Doctor out - but why? With the Time Lords themselves unable to help, it seems the only person who can help the Doctor is himself - or selves...

videos.title: The Three Doctors (2)
videos.overview: The third Doctor and Jo find themselves on an artificial world inside the black hole while the second Doctor tries to find a way to control the organism.

videos.title: The Three Doctors (3)
videos.overview: The Time Lord Omega reveals himself to the third Doctor along with plans for vengeance against his own kind.

videos.title: The Three Doctors (4)
videos.overview: Omega reveals the purpose behind bringing the Doctor to his antimatter world, but the Doctor(s) discover a startling fact about Omega that he didn't know himself and eventually strike a bargain.

videos.title: Carnival of Monsters (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor attempts to test his new dematerialisation circuit by taking Jo to Metebelis Three but instead the TARDIS arrives in the hold of a 1920s cargo ship.

videos.title: Carnival of Monsters (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo attempt to find a way out of the Scope but, when Vorg attempts to entertain the Minorans, the crew of the Bernice suddenly become a lot more dangerous.

videos.title: Carnival of Monsters (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo return to the Bernice to try and aid their escape but find themselves pursued by the Drashigs.

videos.title: Carnival of Monsters (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor escapes from the Scope and joins forces with Vorg to try and save its inhabitants but Kalik is still determined to use the Drashigs to start a rebellion.

videos.title: Frontier in Space (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo land on a spaceship in the far future as it is attacked by Ogrons, which the human crew see as Draconians. The Doctor and Jo are taken to Earth as spies.

videos.title: Frontier in Space (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo are taken to Earth, where both humans and Draconians believe them to be a spy for the other side.

videos.title: Frontier in Space (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor is sentenced to life imprisonment at a lunar penal colony while Jo encounters an old enemy.

videos.title: Frontier in Space (4)
videos.overview: The Master rescues the Doctor from the lunar penal colony, aiming to take him and Jo to the Ogrons' planet, and the Doctor's attempt to escape leaves him stranded in space.

videos.title: Frontier in Space (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Jo and the Master are taken to Draconia, where the Doctor tries to convince the Draconians of the truth.

videos.title: Frontier in Space (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Williams and the Draconian Prince head to the Ogrons' planet to find evidence of the Master's actions but the Master tricks Jo into leading them into a trap.

videos.title: Planet of the Daleks (1)
videos.overview: The planet Spiridon, the year 2540. The Doctor and Jo arrive on the trail of the Daleks, and find unexpected allies in the shape of a Thal suicide squad. But what has brought the Daleks here in the first place?

videos.title: Planet of the Daleks (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor is captured by the Daleks, while Jo is rescued by a friendly Spridon named Wester.

videos.title: Planet of the Daleks (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Codal escape from their cell and meet up with the Thal commandos who are trying to get into the Dalek base.

videos.title: Planet of the Daleks (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor and his friends escape from the Dalek base, prompting the Daleks to devise a plan to wipe them out.

videos.title: Planet of the Daleks (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor and his friends ambush two Daleks as part of their plan to get back into the city, but the Daleks are on the verge of unleashing their virus.

videos.title: Planet of the Daleks (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor and his friends prepare to refreeze the Dalek army but the Dalek Supreme has arrived on the planet determined to destroy them all.

videos.title: The Green Death (1)
videos.overview: While the Doctor plans a holiday to Metebelis Three, Jo and the Brigadier are intrigued by a mysterious death at a coal mine in Llanfairfach, which is being blamed on local company Global Chemicals.

videos.title: The Green Death (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and the Brigadier attempt to rescue Jo and Bert from the mine but Global Chemicals prove distinctly uncooperative.

videos.title: The Green Death (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Jo manage to escape from the mine with a maggot egg but Stevens is determined to stop them analysing it.

videos.title: The Green Death (4)
videos.overview: The Brigadier calls in a full UNIT force to deal with the giant maggots while the Doctor infiltrates Global Chemicals to find out what is really going on.

videos.title: The Green Death (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor manages to escape from BOSS with help from Yates and discovers Cliff has been infected by a giant maggot.

videos.title: The Green Death (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor attempts to destroy the giant maggots and cure Cliff but the real threat is BOSS, who is poised to take over all the world's computers.

videos.title: The Time Warrior (1)
videos.overview: England, the 12th century. Robber baron Irongron is recruited by Linx, a Sontaran warrior whose starship has been forced down on Earth. Linx is forced to use a time-travel device to steal resources and scientists from the future to repair his ship, but in doing so involves UNIT and the Doctor...

videos.title: The Time Warrior (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor tracks the missing scientists to Irongron's castle, where Linx is using them to repair his spaceship and construct advanced weapons for Irongron.

videos.title: The Time Warrior (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor escapes the castle with Sarah and Hal and must persuade Sir Edward to trust him before Irongron launches an attack on them.

videos.title: The Time Warrior (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor attempts to return the scientists to their own time, before Linx tries to use his spaceship and destroys the entire castle.

videos.title: Invasion (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah return to London in the present day only to find the city strangely deserted, while nearby UNIT are dealing with a series of monster appearances.

videos.title: Invasion of the Dinosaurs (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor attempts to solve the mystery of the monster invasion. His first move - the capture of a dinosaur.

videos.title: Invasion of the Dinosaurs (3)
videos.overview: Yates sabotages the Doctor's equipment to stop him finding the location of Whitaker's base but then the tyrannosaur escapes, placing Sarah in danger.

videos.title: Invasion of the Dinosaurs (4)
videos.overview: Sarah attempts to find a way off the spaceship while the Doctor tries to track down the source of the time displacements.

videos.title: Invasion of the Dinosaurs (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor has been framed as the monster maker by Finch and is on the run from the army, while Sarah attempts to alert UNIT to what Grover is up to.

videos.title: Invasion of the Dinosaurs (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor is rescued from Finch by the Brigadier and Benton and tries to persuade them to stop Grover before millions of people are erased from history.

videos.title: Death to the Daleks (1)
videos.overview: The barren planet Exxilon, some time in the future. The TARDIS is forced down by a total power failure and the Doctor and Sarah meet a stranded Earth crew who came here to mine for priceless medical supplies. But what is causing the power failures? And why have the Daleks come here too?

videos.title: Death to the Daleks (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and the MSC crew join forces with the Daleks to mine the parrinium, only to come under attack from the Exxilons.

videos.title: Death to the Daleks (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah meet up with Bellal, who helps them escape from the Daleks and explains the origin of the City.

videos.title: Death to the Daleks (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Bellal continue to penetrate the City's defences while Sarah and Jill try to stop the Daleks leaving with the parrinium.

videos.title: The Monster of Peladon (1)
videos.overview: The planet Peladon, some time in the future. Mining disputes threaten the peace of the planet, and as the Doctor and Jo arrive, it seems that the ghost of Aggedor walks once more...

videos.title: The Monster of Peladon (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor is rescued by Gebek, prompting him to try and help the miners, but his advice results in Ettis launching another attack on the armoury.

videos.title: The Monster of Peladon (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah pacify Aggedor and the Doctor encourages the Queen to make peace with the miners, but Ortron soon has him under arrest again.

videos.title: The Monster of Peladon (4)
videos.overview: The Ice Warriors take control of the planet and force the miners to return to work but Ettis takes the opportunity to try and destroy the citadel.

videos.title: The Monster of Peladon (5)
videos.overview: Sarah and Alpha Centauri decide to try and alert the Federation to what the Ice Warriors are up to but first they have to escape from the throne room.

videos.title: The Monster of Peladon (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor turns the Aggedor spirit against the Ice Warriors to aid the Peladonians in their battle but Eckersley attacks him with the security system.

videos.title: Planet of the Spiders (1)
videos.overview: While the Doctor carries out an investigation into ESP, Mike Yates asks Sarah to look into some strange goings on at a meditation centre he's attending.

videos.title: Planet of the Spiders (2)
videos.overview: Lupton forms an alliance with the spider to steal the Doctor's blue crystal, while Sarah and Mike attempt to alert people to what they've seen.

videos.title: Planet of the Spiders (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah head to the meditation centre to try and get the crystal back while Lupton prepares to return it to Metebelis Three. But all their plans are disrupted when it is stolen by Tommy.

videos.title: Planet of the Spiders (4)
videos.overview: Sarah is captured by the spiders' guards while the Doctor tries to help Arak and the others strike back against the spiders.

videos.title: Planet of the Spiders (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor escapes from the spiders' larder only to encounter the Great One, while Sarah makes a deal with the Queen Spider.

videos.title: Planet of the Spiders (6)
videos.overview: K'Anpo persuades the Doctor he must face his fear and return the crystal to the Great One. But first they need to get past Barnes and his men.

videos.title: Robot (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor changes form again. Before he has fully re-covered, something of colossal strength steals a secret weapon, and the convalescent Doctor starts to investigate.

videos.title: Robot (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah Jane become convinced Think Tank are behind the electronic component thefts but are unable to stop them carrying out another raid.

videos.title: Robot (3)
videos.overview: Sarah Jane and Kettlewell infiltrate an SRS meeting to try and find out what Miss Winters is up to but there is a surprise in store.

videos.title: Robot (4)
videos.overview: UNIT attempt to get into the bunker to stop Miss Winters setting off the world's nuclear missiles but first they have to get past the K1.

videos.title: The Ark in Space (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor's attempt to give Harry a trip in the TARDIS sees the two of them and Sarah Jane arriving onboard a space station in the far future, with some rather deadly security mechanisms.

videos.title: The Ark in Space (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Harry revive the Ark's medtech, Vira, to help Sarah Jane. But when station commander Noah is revived, he becomes suspicious of the newcomers.

videos.title: The Ark in Space (3)
videos.overview: Knowing that Noah has been infected by the Wirrn, the Doctor persuades Vira to halt the reviving of her people, knowing it will place them in danger as well.

videos.title: The Ark in Space (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor tries to protect the humans still in cryogenic suspension from the Wirrn, who are determined to use Earth as their new breeding ground.

videos.title: The Sontaran Experiment (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Sarah Jane and Harry teleport to Earth to ensure the planet is safe for the survivors on board Nerva Beacon to return and reinhabit their world. A Sontaran named Styre has captured a group of humans and is conducting experiments on them to discover the human body's weaknesses, as part of the Sontaran's goal for domination of the galaxy.

videos.title: The Sontaran Experiment (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor learns that Styre has been experimenting on the Galsec crewmembers to pave the way for a Sontaran invasion of Earth and decides the only way to halt his plans is to challenge him to a duel.

videos.title: Genesis of the Daleks (1)
videos.overview: The planet Skaro, the distant past. The Time Lords divert the Doctor, Sarah Jane and Harry to this war-torn world, and give the Doctor a mission: the evil of the Daleks is about to be born here, and the Doctor is to try to ensure they evolve into less lethally aggressive beings - or, failing that, to avert their creation altogether. But has even the Doctor the right to commit genocide?

videos.title: Genesis of the Daleks (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Harry are taken to the Kaled bunker where Davros is preparing to demonstrate the Daleks, while Sarah Jane is captured by the Thals and taken to their city as a slave worker.

videos.title: Genesis of the Daleks (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Harry head to the Kaled city to alert the authorities to Davros' plans while Sarah Jane and Sevrin are forced to work on the completion of the Thals' rocket.

videos.title: Genesis of the Daleks (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor fails to prevent the Thals from destroying the Kaled city but they don't have long to enjoy their victory before the Daleks attack.

videos.title: Genesis of the Daleks (5)
videos.overview: The Doctor is forced to give Davros full details of future Dalek victories but opposition to Davros' plans is growing among the Kaleds and soon there is open rebellion.

videos.title: Genesis of the Daleks (6)
videos.overview: Gharman tries to convince the Kaleds to vote against the Dalek project but Davros has a trick up his sleeve, while the Doctor works to destroy the tape recording of Dalek victory and the Thals plan an intervention of their own.

videos.title: Revenge of the Cybermen (1)
videos.overview: The orbit of Jupiter, the 25th century. Arriving back on the Nerva Beacon much earlier in history, the Doctor and his friends discover the satellite beset by space plague while its crew struggles to keep space traffic away from Voga, the newest moon of Jupiter. But what is the connection between Voga, the plague, and some old enemies of the Doctor?

videos.title: Revenge of the Cybermen (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor transmits Sarah Jane and Harry down to Voga to cure Sarah Jane of the Cybermat's poison but Kellman's sabotage means he is unable to bring them back.

videos.title: Revenge of the Cybermen (3)
videos.overview: The Cybermen force the Doctor, Stevenson and Lester to carry bombs to the centre of Voga while Sarah Jane, Harry and Tyrum decide to contact Vorus.

videos.title: Revenge of the Cybermen (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Harry and Lester try to destroy the Cybermen's relay device, while the Vogans prepare to destroy Nerva even though Sarah Jane is still on board.

videos.title: Terror of the Zygons (1)
videos.overview: Scotland, the near future. Something is smashing oil rigs off the Scottish coast, and UNIT have been called in to investigate. The Brigadier summons the Doctor to Earth to help in the investigation, but it soon becomes clear some kind of alien presence is at work...

videos.title: Terror of the Zygons (2)
videos.overview: The Zygon traps the Doctor and Sarah Jane in a decompression chamber while Harry is taken to the aliens' underwater ship.

videos.title: Terror of the Zygons (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and the Brigadier begin to realise who the Zygon imposters among them are while Sarah Jane discovers a secret tunnel to the underwater ship.

videos.title: Terror of the Zygons (4)
videos.overview: UNIT attempt to track down the Zygon ship while Broton prepares to have the Skarasen attack London.

videos.title: Planet of Evil (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah answer a distress call and find themselves on Zeta Minor, the last planet of the known universe, where a Morestran expedition has gone missing.

videos.title: Planet of Evil (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor realises that Zeta Minor lies on the boundary between the universes of matter and anti-matter and something on the planet won't let the Morestrans leave.

videos.title: Planet of Evil (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor makes a deal with the Anti-Matter Beast to return all the anti-matter to the planet but Sorenson is determined to continue his research.

videos.title: Planet of Evil (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor tries to convince Sorenson to sacrifice himself for the rest of the crew but Salamar's attempt to deal with the situation causes their problems to multiply.

videos.title: Pyramids of Mars (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah are drawn off course and, instead of UNIT HQ, they arrive on the same site in 1911.

videos.title: Pyramids of Mars (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Sarah and Laurence try to find a way to sever Sutekh's link to the mummies while poacher Ernie Clements finds the priory surrounded by a forcefield.

videos.title: Pyramids of Mars (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah try to destroy Sutekh's rocket but the Osiran's mental powers prove too great for them.

videos.title: Pyramids of Mars (4)
videos.overview: Sutekh forces the Doctor to transport Scarman and a mummy to Mars, where the Doctor and Sarah try to stop them destroying the Eye of Horus.

videos.title: The Android Invasion (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah return to Earth in the present day to find a strangely deserted village and woods stalked by white-clad figures.

videos.title: The Android Invasion (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor suspects Crayford brought something to Earth in his rocket, as he and Sarah find themselves hunted by UNIT.

videos.title: The Android Invasion (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor is captured by Styggron and left to die in the destruction of the fake village but Sarah escapes from the disorientation chamber to try and rescue him.

videos.title: The Android Invasion (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah reach Earth and try to warn the research centre about the Kraal invasion before Styggron unleashes his virus.

videos.title: The Brain of Morbius (1)
videos.overview: The storm-lashed planet Karn. Near a graveyard of crashed starships, the demented surgeon Solon hides in his castle, the last acolyte of the Time Lord despot Morbius. He only needs one final item to make his master live again... and then the Doctor and Sarah arrive...

videos.title: The Brain of Morbius (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor is captured by the Sisterhood, and Sarah Jane is blinded freeing him. The Doctor has no choice but to go back for a cure, unaware that he is leaving Sarah Jane in the hands of a treacherous Dr. Solon and the renegade Time Lord Morbius.

videos.title: The Brain of Morbius (3)
videos.overview: While the Doctor goes to confront the Sisterhood to seek a cure for Sarah Jane's blindness, Solon realizes that he must transfer Morbius' brain into a new body before it is too late.

videos.title: The Brain of Morbius (4)
videos.overview: Morbius lives once more, but as a rampaging beast. The Doctor is forced to ally with Dr. Solon to bring him to heel, but the two disagree about what should happen to Morbius.

videos.title: The Seeds of Doom (1)
videos.overview: The Antarctic, the near future. A strange seed-pod is unearthed from 20-thousand-year-old ice. The Doctor and Sarah go to investigate, but are too late to prevent the pod infecting a scientist and unleashing a threat to all animal life on Earth...

videos.title: The Seeds of Doom (2)
videos.overview: Two employees of the millionaire Harrison Chase arrive at the Antarctic base, and they will stop at nothing to get hold of the second seed-pod.

videos.title: The Seeds of Doom (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah Jane return to England after their Antarctic ordeal and Chase tries to eliminate them, but they escape and track him down at his estate, where he is preparing to open the Krynoid pod.

videos.title: The Seeds of Doom (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor is captured by Chase, who plans to breed the stolen Krynoid pod. He is placed in an automated compost hopper and only Sarah Jane can save him... but will she make it before the Krynoid grows to fruition ?

videos.title: The Seeds of Doom (5)
videos.overview: The Krynoid grows to a monstrous size and traps the Doctor and the others in a cottage. The creature demands they turn over the Doctor, while Chase seeks to make an alliance with the alien vegetation.

videos.title: The Seeds of Doom (6)
videos.overview: The Doctor, Sarah Jane, and Scorby are trapped in the manor as a possessed Chase stalks them from within, while the gigantic Krynoid prepares to crush them from without. Worse, the alien plant is ready to germinate, spreading its seeds across England.

videos.title: The Masque of Mandragora (1)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah arrive in Renaissance Italy unaware that they have brought a deadly alien energy force with them.

videos.title: The Masque of Mandragora (2)
videos.overview: The Mandragora energy joins forces with the secret Brotherhood of Demnos. Count Federico plots to steal the Dukedom of San Martino from his nephew, Giuliano.

videos.title: The Masque of Mandragora (3)
videos.overview: Tempted by the promises of ultimate power offered by Mandragora, Hieronymous plots to eliminate the threat posed by the Doctor and uses an unwitting Sarah as his weapon.

videos.title: The Masque of Mandragora (4)
videos.overview: As the leading scholars of the era assemble in the palace for the masque, Mandragora prepares to attack, intent on sending the world into a new dark age.

videos.title: The Hand of Fear (1)
videos.overview: England, the near future. The TARDIS materialises in a quarry and Sarah is trapped under a rockfall. But what is the origin of the fossilised hand she is found gripping ? And who is the Eldrad she keeps mumbling about ?

videos.title: The Hand of Fear (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Professor Watson struggle to stop first Sarah Jane and then Driscoll from obeying the strange and dangerous orders of the stone hand, which has suddenly come to life.

videos.title: The Hand of Fear (3)
videos.overview: The energy of the reactor has returned the mysterious Eldrad to life. The Doctor agrees to take her back to Kastria. But what is waiting for them there?

videos.title: The Hand of Fear (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Sarah race to save the mortally wounded Eldrad. But they find that everything is not quite as she told them.

videos.title: The Deadly Assassin (1)
videos.overview: Gallifrey, planet of the Time Lords. Summoned home by a premonition of murder, the Doctor discovers a dark conspiracy at the highest levels of Time Lord society... and his oldest enemy, who poses a threat to the existence of Gallifrey itself...

videos.title: The Deadly Assassin (2)
videos.overview: The President of the High Council has been killed and the Doctor is the prime suspect. The Time Lords are eager to dispense quick justice and the Doctor must race agains the clock to discover the truth... and an old enemy.

videos.title: The Deadly Assassin (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor has entered the computation Matrix to prove his innocence. But his opponent is prepared for him and the two engage in a mental duel to the death.

videos.title: The Deadly Assassin (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor has won his fight in the Matrix and revealed the assassin. But the Master is not defeated and sets a plan in motion that could destroy the Time Lords.

videos.title: The Face of Evil (1)
videos.overview: An unnamed planet, the distant future. Arriving in a place that seems oddly familiar, the Doctor finds the savage Sevateem tribe battling to free their captive god, Xoanon, from the Evil One and his Tesh servants. But can the whole situation really be the Doctor's fault?

videos.title: The Face of Evil (2)
videos.overview: The Sevateem launch another attack to try to free Xoanon as the Doctor tries to figure out his role in their past. But his only chance to win their trust is to face a deadly test.

videos.title: The Face of Evil (3)
videos.overview: The Doctor has broken through the barrier and found the Tesh. But he comes to an awful realisation about Xoanon.

videos.title: The Face of Evil (4)
videos.overview: The Doctor tries to fix the mad computer Xoanon. But it is determined to stop him – even if it must destroy the entire world!

videos.title: The Robots of Death (1)
videos.overview: An unnamed world, an unknown time. A vast mining vessel trawls a sea of mineral sand for valuable ores, the tiny human crew served by an army of humanoid robots. But as the Doctor and Leela arrive, one of the crew is found murdered... and if they didn't do it, who did?

videos.title: The Robots of Death (2)
videos.overview: The Doctor and Leela are suspected of murder. But the real foe is using robots to cut down the crew – and even sabotage the sand miner itself!
